The signed paperwork agrees. Amendment 1 (executed 2025-10-20, effective 2025-11-01) grants a 10% retention discount on per-seat charges, and the 2026 renewal order form (signed 2026-06-18) carries that 10% over unchanged.

I posted this as a reply to your message in #coastal-team.
